objective: Gate 12E. Determinar mediante conteos agregados y sin exponer PII si los socios actuales de CavaSocios_Socios pueden vincularse de forma determinista con Cliente_Catalogo usando Email/EmailPrincipal y Telefono/TelefonoPrincipal. No crear columnas, FKs, tablas puente ni migraciones. Clasificar la capacidad de matching como DETERMINISTIC_MATCH, AMBIGUOUS, UNMATCHED o NOT_DETERMINABLE.

queries.name: gate12e_email_match_aggregate
queries.sql:
WITH S AS (
    SELECT SocioID,
           LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Email))) AS EmailNorm
    FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
),
M AS (
    SELECT S.SocioID,
           COUNT(DISTINCT C.ClienteID) AS Matches
    FROM S
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Cliente_Catalogo C
      ON S.EmailNorm IS NOT NULL
     AND S.EmailNorm <> ''
     AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.EmailPrincipal))) = S.EmailNorm
    GROUP BY S.SocioID
)
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unique_match,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched
FROM M

queries.name: gate12e_phone_match_aggregate
queries.sql:
WITH S AS (
    SELECT SocioID,
           REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
             LTRIM(RTRIM(Telefono)),
             ' ',''),'-',''),'(',''),')',''),'+','') AS PhoneNorm
    FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
),
M AS (
    SELECT S.SocioID,
           COUNT(DISTINCT C.ClienteID) AS Matches
    FROM S
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Cliente_Catalogo C
      ON S.PhoneNorm IS NOT NULL
     AND S.PhoneNorm <> ''
     AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
           LTRIM(RTRIM(C.TelefonoPrincipal)),
           ' ',''),'-',''),'(',''),')',''),'+','') = S.PhoneNorm
    GROUP BY S.SocioID
)
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unique_match,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched
FROM M

queries.name: gate12e_email_phone_same_client_aggregate
queries.sql:
WITH M AS (
    SELECT S.SocioID,
           COUNT(DISTINCT C.ClienteID) AS Matches
    FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios S
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Cliente_Catalogo C
      ON S.Email IS NOT NULL
     AND S.Telefono IS NOT NULL
     AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.EmailPrincipal)))
         = LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Email)))
     AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
           LTRIM(RTRIM(C.TelefonoPrincipal)),
           ' ',''),'-',''),'(',''),')',''),'+','')
         = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(
           LTRIM(RTRIM(S.Telefono)),
           ' ',''),'-',''),'(',''),')',''),'+','')
    GROUP BY S.SocioID
)
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deterministic,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Matches=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched
FROM M

constraints: Do not return names, emails, phones, RFCs, GUIDs or ClienteIDs
Do not create ClienteID, PersonaID, VinculoID, FK or bridge table
If deterministic linkage is not proven return NOT_DETERMINABLE
